regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Distinguish /ʁ/ and /l/ when meaning changes
lessons.objective: Hear and produce French /ʁ/ versus /l/ in riz and lit, then carry the contrast into a day-trip conversation.
lessons.focus: Riz /ʁi/ means rice; lit /li/ means bed. Keep the initial consonant distinct, then compare route and rue with lac and ligne in a longer phrase.

words.fr: Le lac est au bout de la route.
words.en: The lake is at the end of the road.

words.fr: La ligne bleue mène au lac.
words.en: The blue line leads to the lake.

words.fr: Je mange du riz après la marche.
words.en: I eat rice after the walk.

words.fr: Je vais au lit après le repas.
words.en: I go to bed after the meal.

reader.fr: Nous suivons une route qui traverse une rue du village.
reader.en: We follow a road that crosses a village street.

reader.fr: Une ligne bleue sur la carte mène au lac.
reader.en: A blue line on the map leads to the lake.

reader.fr: Après la marche, je mange du riz avec mon ami.
reader.en: After the walk, I eat rice with my friend.

reader.fr: Le soir, je vais au lit en pensant au lac.
reader.en: In the evening, I go to bed thinking about the lake.

speaking.scene: Planning a walk to a lake and the evening after
speaking.opening: La ligne bleue mène au lac.
goals: Confirm the road to the lake.
Say what you will eat after the walk.
Say when you will go to bed.
speaking.closure: Oui, le lac est au bout de la route.

see.prompt: Contrast riz and lit, then sort route, rue, lac, and ligne by initial /ʁ/ or /l/.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for lake before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for riz or lit in the recorded sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The lake is at the end of the road.'
type.answerRef: Le lac est au bout de la route.

say.prompt: Tell your companion that the blue line leads to the lake.
say.answerRef: La ligne bleue mène au lac.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the route to the lake and the evening meal.

lessons.title: Read /s/ spellings and hear /z/
lessons.objective: Use French s, c, and ç for /s/ in context while distinguishing the voiced /z/ in nearby words.
lessons.focus: Compare salle, cinéma, and façade for /s/ with zone, rose, and maison for /z/. The letter s may have a different sound between vowels; read the whole word.

words.fr: La salle est dans la zone B.
words.en: The screening room is in area B.

words.fr: Le cinéma est derrière la maison.
words.en: The cinema is behind the house.

reader.fr: Le cinéma se trouve derrière une maison à la façade rose.
reader.en: The cinema is behind a house with a pink facade.

reader.fr: Dans l'entrée, je lis que notre salle est dans la zone B.
reader.en: In the entrance, I read that our screening room is in area B.

reader.fr: Mon ami demande : « Ça commence à six heures ? »
reader.en: My friend asks, 'Does it start at six o'clock?'

reader.fr: Je regarde le billet et je confirme l'heure.
reader.en: I look at the ticket and confirm the time.

speaking.opening: Bonjour, où est la salle dans la zone B ?
goals: Ask where the screening room is.

see.prompt: Mark /s/ in salle, cinéma, façade and /z/ in zone, rose, maison.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for facade before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for salle or zone in the recorded cinema sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The facade is pink.'

say.prompt: Confirm that the film starts at six o'clock.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences locating the cinema and its screening room.

lessons.title: Read /ʒ/ in j and soft g words
lessons.objective: Recognize the French /ʒ/ sound in j and g-before-front-vowel spellings during a zoo visit.
lessons.focus: Compare jour, joli, and journal with gens, girafe, and gilet. Keep /ʒ/ consistent while reading each word in a sentence.

words.en: The people are looking at the giraffe.
The guide is wearing a vest.

words.fr: C'est un joli jour pour visiter le zoo.
words.en: It's a lovely day to visit the zoo.

words.fr: Je lis le journal près de l'entrée.
words.en: I read the newspaper near the entrance.

reader.fr: Aujourd'hui, je vais au zoo avec un ami.
reader.en: Today, I am going to the zoo with a friend.

reader.fr: Un guide en gilet nous montre la girafe.
reader.en: A guide wearing a vest shows us the giraffe.

reader.fr: Les gens regardent la girafe pendant que je prends une photo.
reader.en: People watch the giraffe while I take a photo.

reader.fr: Plus tard, je lis un journal près de l'entrée.
reader.en: Later, I read a newspaper near the entrance.

speaking.scene: Asking a zoo guide about the giraffe
speaking.opening: Bonjour, les gens regardent la girafe.
goals: Say why it is a good day to visit.
speaking.closure: Merci, c'est un joli jour au zoo.

see.prompt: Find /ʒ/ spelled j in jour, joli, journal and g in gens, girafe, gilet.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for giraffe before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for gens or girafe in the recorded zoo sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The people are looking at the giraffe.'

say.prompt: Tell your friend that the guide is wearing a vest.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the guide and the giraffe.

lessons.title: Hear /j/ in y and ill, then check exceptions
lessons.objective: Read French /j/ in famille, fille, payer, and yeux while recognizing that ville and tranquille retain /l/.
lessons.focus: Compare famille and fille with ville and tranquille. The letters ill do not have one universal sound. Use reviewed word models, and also hear /j/ in payer and yeux.

words.fr: La fille a les yeux ouverts.
words.en: The girl has her eyes open.
I am going to pay for the tickets.

reader.fr: Une famille visite la ville un samedi matin.
reader.en: A family visits the city on a Saturday morning.

reader.fr: La fille regarde une vitrine avec les yeux grands ouverts.
reader.en: The girl looks at a shop window with her eyes wide open.

reader.fr: Son père va payer les billets pour le musée.
reader.en: Her father is going to pay for the museum tickets.

reader.fr: Après la visite, ils marchent dans un quartier tranquille.
reader.en: After the visit, they walk through a quiet neighborhood.

speaking.opening: Bonjour, je vais payer les billets pour ma famille.
goals: Say how many family members need tickets.
Explain that the daughter is visiting the city.
Ask where the quiet area is.
speaking.closure: Merci, nous allons visiter la ville.

see.prompt: Compare /j/ in famille and fille with /l/ in ville and tranquille; then find /j/ in payer and yeux.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for family before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for famille or ville in the recorded sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The family visits the city.'

say.prompt: Tell the clerk that you will pay for the tickets.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the family visiting the city and the quiet neighborhood.
